title: Colossians Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Colossians 1: thanksgiving for the saints at Colossae, who the Son is, and the mystery made known among the Gentiles.

questions.text: To whom is this letter addressed?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 addresses the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae, with grace and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

answers.text: The assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father
The saints who are at Philippi with the overseers
The faithful brothers who are in Laodicea
The saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae

questions.text: Where does verse 5 say the hope is laid up for them?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 speaks of the hope which is laid up for them in the heavens, of which they heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News.

answers.text: In the assembly
In the heavens
In the word of the law
In the day of Christ

questions.text: From whom does the text say they learned, calling him a beloved fellow servant?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says they learned of Epaphras, their beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on their behalf.

answers.text: Tychicus
Onesimus
Epaphras
Archippus

questions.text: With what does he pray they may be filled?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says he does not cease praying that they may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding.

answers.text: The knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding
The comfort of the Spirit in all their affliction
The riches of the saints in the inheritance of light
The boldness to speak the word of God without fear

questions.text: Out of what were they delivered, and into what were they brought?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says he delivered them out of the power of darkness and translated them into the Kingdom of the Son of his love.

answers.text: Out of the hand of their enemies, into a land of rest
Out of the power of darkness, into the Kingdom of the Son of his love
Out of the elements of the world, into the law of Moses
Out of their poverty, into the riches of glory

questions.explanation: Verse 15 says he is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

answers.text: The first of the prophets and the last of them
The servant of all and the least of the saints
The image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation
The head of every nation under heaven

questions.text: What does verse 16 say about thrones, dominions, principalities and powers?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says that by him all things in the heavens and on the earth were created, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers, and that all things have been created through him and for him.

answers.text: They were all created through him and for him
They were given the earth to rule for a time
They were stripped of their glory
They were made subject to the assembly

questions.text: Of what does verse 18 say he is the head?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says he is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

answers.text: The powers in the heavenly places
The inheritance of the saints
The hope of the Good News
The body, the assembly

questions.text: Through what does verse 20 say peace was made?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says that through him God reconciled all things to himself, whether on the earth or in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

answers.text: The word of the truth
The blood of his cross
The washing of water
The prayers of the saints

questions.text: What does verse 27 say this mystery is, among the Gentiles?
questions.explanation: Verse 27 says God was pleased to make known the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in them, the hope of glory.

answers.text: The forgiveness of sins through the law
The gathering of all nations to Jerusalem
Christ in them, the hope of glory
The stewardship given to the apostles
